quarterly_data.quarter: Siemens press release: Siemens secures major order to advance sustainable rail (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Siemens Mobility order (release): the Lower Saxony Transport Authority (LNVG) and the Greater Braunschweig Regional Association (RGB) awarded a contract valued at over two billion euros for 113 three-car Mireo Plus B battery trains (83 for LNVG, 30 for RGB), a 30-year digital service and maintenance package and two new Rail Service Centers in Lower Saxony, with options for up to 132 additional trains; the trains will enter passenger service starting at the end of 2031; Siemens calls it the world's largest battery-train order (company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: 113 battery trains; contract valued at over two billion euros; options for up to 132 more; passenger service from end of 2031
quarterly_data.counterparty: Lower Saxony Transport Authority (LNVG); Greater Braunschweig Regional Association (RGB)
